name: Gongbi painting
material: fine-line Chinese painting using controlled outlines and layered color on silk or prepared paper
fabrication_process: build flat/translucent color layers within forms
develop textile, face, flora and ornament detail with controlled brushwork
edge_behavior: Edges are deliberate and controlled; outlines separate forms more clearly than spontaneous ink-wash traditions.
color_behavior: Colors can be refined and layered with mineral/vegetal pigments depending on context; avoid generic neon saturation.
surface_behavior: Smooth prepared silk/paper field with visible brush-built color rather than photographic surface gloss.
composition_behavior: Favor ordered figure/flower/bird detail, clear silhouette, patterned textiles and elegant negative space.
aging_weathering: fading and silk/paper aging depend on artifact state
paint losses should follow support/paint-layer behavior

prompt_fragments.core: Use precise fine contour drawing and patient layered color: controlled garment folds, hair ornaments and facial planes, with crisp but organic brush edges on silk/paper.

evaluation_criteria: layered color remains integrated with substrate
detail supports hierarchy rather than noise
scope_note: This module controls material/production behavior. It does not select an era by itself.
